title: Xenoris Blade
description: Epic custom 3D weapons and immersive RPG elements to level up your Minecraft adventure.
body:
✨ 3D MODEL & ASSET PACK: Upgrade Your Minecraft Visuals!
Bored of the standard blocky look? Get your hands on the ultimate collection of Custom 3D Models for Minecraft, perfectly paired with an immersive RPG gameplay vibe. These models are meticulously designed to bring an epic and dynamic feel to your world, gear, or custom mobs.

Perfect for:

Survival Servers

RPG Servers

Adventure Map Makers

Elevate your gameplay experience and take your server's immersion to the next level with stunning, high-quality details!

🛠️ Anvil Rename Features (Custom Item Textures)
You can easily get these custom models in-game simply by renaming specific weapons or items using an Anvil! No complex setup required.

How to use:

Place your weapon/item into the Anvil.

Rename the item to the specific custom name ("Xenoris Blade").

Boom! Your item's visual model will instantly change into the epic custom 3D model!
(Make sure you have OptiFine or the CIT Resewn mod installed if you are playing on Java Edition for this feature to work).
